reply: Thank you for explaining that you sent an endorsed bill and letters asking for it to be applied as a credit to your auto loan, and have not received a response you accept. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the auto lending team. Please keep your certified mail records, and ask in writing for your current balance and the accepted ways to make payments. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you feel you overpaid for your car, which has needed several repairs, and that you still have about two years left on the loan. We understand your disappointment. Your complaint has been logged for review by the auto lending team. Please keep your repair records and sales contract, and ask in writing about any options to lower your payment or refinance. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that one of four payments was applied to $520.00 in late fees instead of your monthly payment, and that your account is still marked delinquent. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the payments team. Please keep proof of all four payments, and ask in writing for a corrected payment history and a review of the fees. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you have not received the itemized transaction records you asked for, and that your refinance request was denied despite what the dealer told you. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the auto lending team. Please send a written request for the itemized records and your Truth in Lending disclosure, and keep a copy. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your auto loan application led to several hard inquiries and was declined, despite advertising suggesting everyone could qualify. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the auto lending team. You can ask in writing for the specific reasons for the decision and the credit report used, and dispute any inaccurate items. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your vehicle was repossessed by a servicer you say you have no contract with, and that your requests for account documents have not been answered. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the auto lending team. Please send a written request for the contract, any assignment to the servicer and a full payment history. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you were required to make a $1,000.00 down payment that you believe was not properly disclosed. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the auto lending team. Please keep the advertisement you saw and your sales contract, and ask in writing for an explanation of the down payment terms. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you have sent the same GAP claim documents eight times for your totaled vehicle and are still told they are not sufficient. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the auto lending team. Please ask in writing for a specific list of what is missing from your GAP claim, and keep copies of everything you sent. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you keep receiving calls about a balance on a car you believe was paid in full by your insurer, and that you have not received the itemized statement. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please send a written request for an itemized statement of any amount claimed, and keep the insurer's payoff records. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you have asked for two months for the documents on your vehicle purchase, including the contract and the reason funding was closed. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the auto lending team. Please send your request in writing with a list of each document you need, and keep a copy. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

We are sorry for the loss of your sister. Thank you for explaining that you were told your loan could not be changed after your co-signer's credit dropped, and that your truck has now been repossessed. We understand how difficult this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the auto lending team. Please ask in writing what is needed to recover the truck. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you found several credit inquiries you did not authorize when reviewing your credit report. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please dispute each unauthorized inquiry with the credit reporting companies, include your identity theft report, and keep checking your reports. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that transferring your car registration to another state has been delayed by conflicting information from many representatives. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the title services team. Please send a written request for the steps and documents needed to complete the transfer, and keep your case notes. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your car's engine failed within months, that you turned the car in, and that the settlement offered seems unfair to you. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the auto lending team. Please ask in writing for a breakdown of the balance after the vehicle was sold, and keep your repair records. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your car was totaled, that you are paying the remaining balance after insurance, and that your new credit applications were declined. We understand how hard it is without a car for work. Your complaint has been logged for review by the auto lending team. Please ask in writing for the reasons for each decision and for a payment plan on the remaining balance. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you recovered your car and completed the reinstatement package, but the car has not been reinstated in your name and you cannot renew your tags. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the title services team. Please keep a copy of the package and proof of the fees you paid, and ask in writing for the status. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your car was repossessed while you were waiting to resolve its mechanical problems and find new work. We understand how difficult this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the auto lending team. Please ask in writing for the amount needed to recover the car and copies of any notices, and keep your repair records. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you paid $1,800.00 to catch up during an illness, but are now told you are three payments behind and owe $1,600.00. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for urgent review by the auto lending team. Please keep proof of your payment, and send a written request for a payment history showing how it was applied. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you voluntarily surrendered your car after its engine failed, and that late payments and interest are still being reported. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the auto lending team. Please ask in writing for a breakdown of the balance after the surrender, and dispute any inaccurate reporting with the credit reporting companies. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a former co-worker was contacted about your auto loan. We understand why this concerns you. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team, including the reason for that contact. Please write down the date and what your co-worker was told, and send a written request about how you want to be contacted. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you asked for validation of your auto loan debt and do not accept the contract you were sent. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the auto lending team. Please keep copies of your letters and the documents you received, and ask in writing for a full payment history. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that the insurance check for your totaled vehicle was cashed weeks ago but has not been applied to your account. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the payments team. Please ask your insurer for proof of when and where the check was cashed, and send it in writing to the lender. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you are receiving calls about an urgent matter on your new phone number, even though you have no relationship with the caller. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please do not share personal information, check the number against official contact details, and ask in writing to be removed. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you believe your auto loan was paid based on a form you filed, and that you disagree with the earlier response. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the auto lending team. Please ask in writing for a current statement and a full payment history showing any payments received. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your car was repossessed without warning even though you are ahead on payments, and that your bank says it did not order the repossession. We understand how upsetting this is. Your complaint has been logged for urgent review by the auto lending team. Please keep proof of your payments and the report you filed, and ask in writing for the car's return. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that the high interest rate on your auto loan makes it hard to trade in your car, and that you need a larger vehicle for your child. We understand your concern on a fixed income. Your complaint has been logged for review by the auto lending team. Please ask in writing for a payoff quote and any refinancing options. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your car's transmission failed days after purchase and continued to fail after repairs, putting you in danger on the highway. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the auto lending team. Please keep the repair records and warranty, and ask in writing about any warranty or return options for the vehicle. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your financing application was declined and that you disagree with the reasons given. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the auto lending team. You can ask in writing for the specific reasons for the decision and the credit report used, and dispute any inaccurate information. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that after your RV loan moved to a new bank, your payments were reversed or not found, and you were contacted by collections. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the payments team. Please keep the receipts for each payment, and ask in writing for a full payment history and for any late marks to be reviewed. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you asked for an insurance check for hail damage to be applied to your loan payoff, and were later told you must show proof of repairs. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the auto lending team. Please keep the secure messages, and ask in writing for the requirements for applying insurance funds. You will receive an update once the review is complete.
